title: List answer
description: The answer of the command list, on standard output: the machines at the vendor that the adapter made for the request's node pool. The answer is at most 1 MiB. It has no version. A member this schema does not define is refused.

machines.description: The machines of the node pool, empty when the node pool has none. A machine that no longer exists at the vendor is not listed.

id.description: The vendor's id of the machine.

key.description: The dispatch the machine was made for, the key of its make request.

state.description: The machine's state at the vendor. starting: the vendor is starting the machine. running: the machine runs. stopped: the machine stopped and still exists. deleting: the vendor is deleting the machine.

started.description: When the vendor started the machine, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds.
